Welcome from the Headteacher
St Joseph's Infant, Nursery & Junior Schools are two schools in the heart of Chichester. (Please see the junior school website for their information www.stjosephscejunior.school) We are proud to serve our community as schools who are passionate about seeing every child flourish. The staff teams work together to get to know every child and to provide the very best education in our unique setting as two schools, within one site. This allows us to provide specialist early years and infant education and a specialist junior education, whilst providing a seamless transition between the two schools - supporting, caring for and inspiring children from age 2-11.
Two Schools, One Journey
St Joseph's Infant School and St Joseph's CE Junior School are part of the Diocese of Chichester Academy Trust family of schools.
Come and visit us to find out more about all that is happening at St Joseph's - you can get in touch with us here.

The Week Ahead
St Joseph's Schools, Chichester
What a fantastic first week back. It has been wonderful to welcome all of our pupils back to school and especially to greet new children and families joining our school community. The classrooms have been full of smiles, enthusiasm and excitement for learning, we are already seeing our children settle in brilliantly. Thank you to all our parents and carers for your support. We are looking forward to a fantastic year ahead. Dont forget to check your emails for the Week Ahead every Friday.
